description: The dataset records total phosphorus (TP) concentrations in the Lake Constance Fischbach‑Uttwil site. Observations span 1951‑2009 and include a surface reference (Depth top = 0 m) with two depth intervals: the full water column (Depth bot = 250 m, Depth water = 125 m) and the upper 20 m (Depth bot = 20 m, Depth water = 10 m). TP values range from 0 to 83 µg L⁻¹ and are labeled with a description indicating winter‑mixing or summer upper‑layer averages. All records share the same coordinates (latitude 47.6240°, longitude 9.3755°) and a lake elevation of –252 m. Semantically, Year obs is a temporal key, the depth fields are physical measurements, TP is a water‑quality chemical metric, and the location fields provide geospatial context. These data can be used to track long‑term phosphorus trends, evaluate eutrophication risk, and support lake‑management models.
